beats.event: Born from a stone on Flower Fruit Mountain, becomes Handsome Monkey King
Sees a monkey die of old age; sets off to seek immortality
Trained by Grand Master Bodhi; learns 72 transformations, cloud flight
Jade Emperor gives him minor post as Keeper of the Horses
Rejects the rank; declares himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven
Guards immortal peaches, eats nearly all the ripe ones himself
Steals heavenly wine and Laozi's immortality pills
Defeats a celestial army of 100,000 sent against him
Loses the Buddha's wager, cannot leap out of his palm
Buried under Five Elements Mountain for 500 years
Tang Sanzang finds and frees him to escort the scripture pilgrimage
Guanyin locks a gold ring on his head; mantra brings agony
Becomes first disciple; subdues Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing en route
Fights demons across the journey with his Ruyi Jingu Bang staff
Twenty-plus demon episodes; repeatedly saves his master
Climactic supernatural trials as pilgrims approach India
Party reaches Vulture Peak and receives the Buddhist scriptures
Ascends as the Victorious Fighting Buddha
